title: The genetic landscape of canine tumors: Insights from the Canine Cancer Genome Atlas (CCGA)
title_zh: 犬肿瘤的遗传图谱：来自犬癌基因组图谱（CCGA）的洞见
abstract: The Canine Cancer Genome Atlas (CCGA, https://caninecancergenomeatlas.org/ ) is an open, accessible comparative oncology resource that harmonizes whole-exome data across 10 canine tumor histotypes. It aggregates 667 tumor-normal pairs with curated single-nucleotide variants, insertions and deletions, structural variants, and copy number aberrations. Cohort-depth stratification distinguished primary, exploratory, and descriptive analyses. Selection analyses identified 39 cancer drivers, including recurrent TP53 , PIK3CA , PTEN , SETD2 , MAP3K14 , and FAT4 alterations; copy number events included MYC amplifications and PTEN deletions. Direct comparison with matched human cancers revealed conserved and species-enriched oncogenic mechanisms, pathways, and therapeutic contexts. The CCGA standardizes alignment, variant calling, and annotation through consensus pipelines and provides downloadable data and interactive analyses. This reusable framework advances precision veterinary oncology and strengthens translational bridges to human cancer, supporting comparative and translational research.
abstract_zh: 犬癌基因组图谱（CCGA，https://caninecancergenomeatlas.org/）是一个开放、可访问的比较肿瘤学资源，协调了跨10种犬肿瘤组织学类型的全外显子组数据。它汇总了667对肿瘤-正常样本，包含经整理的单核苷酸变异、插入和缺失、结构变异及拷贝数异常。队列深度分层区分了初级、探索性和描述性分析。选择分析鉴定了39个癌症驱动基因，包括反复出现的TP53、PIK3CA、PTEN、SETD2、MAP3K14和FAT4改变；拷贝数事件包括MYC扩增和PTEN缺失。与匹配的人类癌症直接比较揭示了保守和物种富集的致癌机制、通路及治疗背景。CCGA通过共识流程标准化比对、变异检测和注释，并提供可下载数据和交互式分析。这一可重用框架推动了精准兽医肿瘤学的发展，并加强了与人类癌症的转译桥梁，支持比较和转译研究。
